This sytem has a couple of problems though.
1. Oculus users (both quest and pcvr) usually play through the Oculus client, not necessarily Steam.
2. Steam accounts and VRChat are free, you can make unlimited Steam accounts and bypass it anyways.
I get the idea, but it would make things hard for everyone and not much harder for ban evaders

details:
Many users create second accounts, to deflect the ban and reload the worlds and avatar models or to annoy people who follow the VRChat rules.
This is why I have invented a system that can permanently eliminate toxic people who are banned on the most famous social game in the world.
The current system, as the first image shows. Allows you to create VRChat accounts without using STEAM. Indeed, creating a VRChat account provides advantages instead of doing it on STEAM.
This method is completely wrong. And now I'll explain why.
Users can create infinite accounts without any provision for previous account reports. This means that a user can get a new account every time the previous one is banned or blocked by the users.
How could all this system bypass be remedied?
Simple! Removing the ability for registered users on the VRChat site to go to public worlds, post avatars and worlds.
Users must necessarily connect to the STEAM account in this way, in order to actually play VRChat at 100%.
Each user will get a personal code, which is then linked to steam.
This system already exists.
In this way, the VRChat database will track the STEAM code instead of just banning the account.
This means that if a user creates a vrchat account and does not connect him to steam, he will not be able to use the game,
but if he has recently been banned and links his steam account to vrchat, he will be banned again for violating the rules. Because the system will understand that the steam code is the same one the previous one had received a penance for.
 (if these codes are deleted,
you could do it again to all users with new steam connection codes).
Each user will no longer be banned on the VRChat account,
but they will be registered via the steam subscription code. That code that VRChat sends you to link the STEAM account to the VRChat one.
In this way, if they really want to bypass the system, they have to make a new STEAM account (taking a lot of time) and no longer a new email and a new VRChat account (taking a few seconds).
title: Prevent second accounts (divert the ban)
